_readme: Two-floor pharmaceutical company office. Source deck exports are NOT committed.
No redaction ops in this set: the chosen views carry no client mark. Reception
views were excluded instead - the company's name is applied as wall lettering
behind the desk in every one of them. The lounge views show the same space.
Both floor plans are rendered from the deck's vector pages at 220 dpi and cropped
above the title band, which also removes the approval stamp and our own logo.

cafeteria.alt: Office cafeteria with long tables, coloured chairs and a terracotta wall of ceramic plates
cafeteria.caption: The cafeteria on the upper floor, seating 40. Indicative viewpoint.

ground-floor-plan.alt: Annotated ground floor office plan marking reception, board room, cabins and server rooms
ground-floor-plan.caption: Ground floor: reception and lounge, board room for 17, meeting rooms, cabins, collab area, a 33-desk workstation block, and the IT, server and UPS rooms along the service wall.

first-floor-plan.alt: Annotated first floor office plan marking cabins, workstation blocks, cafeteria and pantry
first-floor-plan.caption: First floor: fourteen cabins around the edge, workstation blocks of 24, 12 and 8, a 40-seat cafeteria, pantry and document room.

reception-lounge.alt: Office visitor lounge with blue and tan sofas, timber panelling and a stone floor
reception-lounge.caption: The visitor lounge: seating for seven, held apart from the reception counter. Indicative viewpoint.

board-room.alt: Board room with a long timber table, acoustic ceiling and a blue panelled wall
board-room.caption: The board room seats 17, with an acoustic ceiling raft over the table. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-room.alt: Meeting room with a ten-seat table, linear pendant and a wall-mounted screen
meeting-room.caption: A meeting room off the main corridor, glazed to borrow light. Indicative viewpoint.

collab-room.alt: Collaboration room with a meeting table, writing wall and a sofa under a yellow graphic
collab-room.caption: The collab room pairs a table with soft seating, so a workshop can change gear. Indicative viewpoint.

calling-pods.alt: Two enclosed single-person calling pods beside a breakout sofa and graphic art
calling-pods.caption: Calling pods: the pressure valve that keeps one-to-one calls out of the meeting rooms. Indicative viewpoint.

collab-lounge.alt: Breakout lounge with a blue sofa against a yellow motivational graphic wall
collab-lounge.caption: Breakout seating beside the collab room, for the conversation that follows a meeting. Indicative viewpoint.

workstations.alt: Open-plan workstation blocks with planter-topped storage between the rows
workstations.caption: Workstation blocks with planters on the storage line, which screens without partitioning. Indicative viewpoint.

workstations-values-wall.alt: Open-plan office with yellow graphic walls carrying single words across the floor
workstations-values-wall.caption: Graphics carry single words across the floor — the cheapest way to make a deep plate feel intentional. Indicative viewpoint.

cafeteria-plate-wall.alt: Cafeteria wall of decorative ceramic plates above banquette seating
cafeteria-plate-wall.caption: The plate wall: one wall does the work, so the rest of the room stays plain. Indicative viewpoint.

washroom.alt: Office washroom with twin basins, round backlit mirrors and a marble wall
washroom.caption: Washrooms are where a fit-out's standard is judged fastest. Indicative viewpoint.
